messages:
Tony (Support): Escalating: Novapulse trial tenant novapulse-prod-42 is seeing repeated embed timeouts during onboarding ingestion runs. Customer-facing demos are failing. They said they'll freeze the pilot unless we fix within 48hrs. @Maria can CS own this? :rotating_light:
Maria (CSM): On it. Can you drop logs + any recent config changes? Also did they hit any quota limits in the console?
Tony (Support): Console shows quota_exceeded spikes. Snippet:

```
2026-03-16T14:08:12Z ERROR embed-service tenant=novapulse-prod-42 rate=810/s limit=500/s quota_exceeded
2026-03-16T14:08:14Z WARN client-timeout route=embed timeout=2s
```

Tony (Support): They started a bulk docs ingest yesterday and toggled "parallel_uploads" to 10 in their SDK.
Maria (CSM): Key risks: stalled activation -> negative renewal signal; blocker for sales demos. Proposed comms + ops plan: (A) Immediate acknowledgement to customer with SLA-style ETA and scheduled troubleshooting, (B) quick temporary uplift of soft limit + smoothing while we investigate, (C) enablement session for their engineers on batching/pacing + SDK best practices, (D) capture product feedback about SDK defaults and suggest improvements. I can be lead for (A) and (C).
Kevin (RevOps): Ping me if mitigation goes past 24h. We'll want to create a short renewal-watch ticket and prep outreach script for AE.
Lina (Engineer): Preliminary root cause: their parallel_uploads bump created bursts that exhausted per-tenant burst credits; embed cluster in us-west-2 is near steady-state capacity. Short-term mitigation: bump soft_limit to 1000/s for 24h and enable request smoothing. Mid-term: recommend client-side batching, default SDK backoff tweaks, and an ops autoscale for embed workers.
Maria (CSM): Draft external message to customer (short):

"Hi Novapulse team — thanks for reporting. We're seeing throttling during your recent ingestion and understand this is impacting demos. We've scheduled a troubleshooting session with our engineers for today and will temporarily raise your embed throughput while we stabilize. We'll also run a short enablement walkthrough on batching backoffs so you can avoid future interruptions. More details in the meeting invite. — Maria, CSM"

Maria (CSM): Also planning a 30m enablement session covering: SDK defaults, batching examples, and a sample ingestion checklist. Will capture their pain points as product feedback.
Tony (Support): Customer replied: "Appreciate fast help. We need uplift for tomorrow's demo — can you confirm now?"
Lina (Engineer): I can prepare the uplift command and the monitoring query. I'll only execute after verbal OK on the call and will post the exact command in this thread before running. Rollback plan: revert to 500/s after 24h unless we sign a longer-term commit.
ops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-novapulse-1764305555 meeting at 2026-03-16T15:30:00Z; attendees: Maria, Lina, Tony, Kevin
Maria (CSM): Action items quick list: - Maria: send the acknowledgement (doing now) + run enablement session. - Lina: prep uplift command + monitoring dashboard. - Tony: keep customer channel warm and note any SDK changes they made. - Kevin: stand by to open renewal-watch if >24h.
Kevin (RevOps): I'll create a renewal-watch card if we breach 24h. Also request AE to offer a goodwill demo credit if we can't restore demos quickly.
Lina (Engineer): Uplift preview (will post on call):

```
# preview only
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.example/api/tenants/novapulse-prod-42/quota -d '{"soft_limit":1000}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>'
# Monitor: GET /metrics?tenant=novapulse-prod-42&window=5m
```

Maria (CSM): Note to team: capture two pieces of feedback in account notes for product: (1) SDK default "parallel_uploads" too aggressive for trials, (2) console quota alerts not surfaced clearly for trial tenants. I'll file product issues after call.
Tony (Support): Will add the config change they made to the ticket and attach any failing request samples.
Maria (CSM): Sent acknowledgement to customer and invited them to the 15:30 troubleshooting + enablement slot. Kept the message high-level per comms guidance.
Kevin (RevOps): Thanks. Keep me posted; I'll prep the AE script.
Maria (CSM): Post-call plan: write a short RCA + prevention checklist, attach enablement recording, and update account health to "At Risk" if sentiment drops.
Tony (Support): -- end thread --
